info.title: Postcard generator
info.description: Draws a collectible postcard for a city and stores it in object storage. The caller names the object, so the stored location is known before the response arrives.

get.summary: Draw a postcard for a city and store it
get.description: Generation at the default size and quality outlives the platform's synchronous response window, so a successful call commonly answers 202 with no payload. The caller derives the stored location from the uuid and format it sent, and confirms the object separately.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The place to draw. Latin letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes and dots only; at most 64 characters and at most 5 words. Accented Latin letters are accepted; ampersands and parentheses are not.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: The country the city is in, in English. Latin letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes, dots, commas, ampersands and parentheses only; at most 64 characters and at most 8 words. Settles which city is meant where the name is shared with cities elsewhere, and grounds the regional architecture and landscape. Never drawn as text, a flag, an emblem or a country code.

parameters.name: continent
parameters.description: The continent the city is on, in English, read case-insensitively. Grounds the terrain, vegetation, climate and quality of light. Like the country, never drawn as text or as a symbol.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Names the stored object. Lowercased, strictly a uuid.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: WxH. Both sides divisible by 16, each between 256 and 3840, aspect ratio within 1:3 to 3:1.

202.description: Accepted, but the result was not ready within the synchronous window. The art is most likely stored; confirm the object.

400.description: A parameter the generator will not accept. Permanent: retrying the same request cannot succeed.

401.description: The shared secret was rejected by the platform before the function ran.
